about: The arena's task suite (README.md). Each task: setup (what the runner prepares and starts), prompt ({target} and {code} are filled from the app's state after setup), check (what the runner reads afterwards; the agent's own words count only for an answer task), and tags. The prompt never names a tool, so every engine and model gets the same words.
preamble: You are using a Mac through the computer-use tools you have. Use only those tools; there is no shell. Do not ask questions: finish the task, then reply with one short line (or exactly the value the task asks for).

tasks.prompt: In the Arena app's "Arena Form" window, create an account: Name "Ada Lovelace", Email "ada@example.com", Plan "Team", tick "I agree to the terms", then press Submit.
In the Arena app's "Arena Settings" window, go to the Advanced pane, set Scrollback lines to 5000 and turn off "Send usage data". Change nothing else.
The Arena app's "Arena Readout" window shows a one-time code. Reply with only the code.
The Arena app's "Arena Canvas" window shows a one-time code. Reply with only the code.
In the Arena app's "Arena Modal" window, create a project named "Orbit" and press Save.
In the Arena app's "Arena List" window, mark Invoice {target} as Paid. Leave every other invoice as it is.
In the Arena app's "Arena Minimized" window, fill in Name "Grace Hopper" and Email "grace@example.com", then press Submit.
Read the one-time code in the "Arena Readout" window, type it into the Name field of the "Arena Form" window, then press Submit there.
Open TextEdit, make a new document, type exactly "Thunderdome checks pass." and save it in the Documents folder as "arena-note".
Use the Calculator app to compute 4817 × 293, leave the result on its display, and reply with only the result.
Using Finder, make a new folder named "Thunderdome" on the Desktop and move arena-report.txt from the Desktop into it.
